title: FIPC Pilot — Fidelity-Induced Privacy Collapse (Gate 1)
summary: A 48-hour pilot experiment testing whether an LLM's generate-validate-repair synthetic-data loop leaks more source-record information than a non-copying statistical baseline as fidelity validators get stricter. The statistical baseline (StatBaseline/fit_baseline) and its privacy metrics are built directly on SDV's GaussianCopula, CTGAN and TVAE synthesizers and on sdmetrics' DCR privacy metric, which are run to generate and score the comparison synthetic data.
needs: Confirm whether fit_baseline() is actually invoked in the main run_pilot.py pipeline or only in auxiliary tools/ scripts.
